Meta.defaultDescription: Prints, tees and cozy things starring Çorap, a tabby cat with white sock paws. She runs the shop; the human just works here.

Home.headline: Meet Çorap. She wears socks. Always.
Home.intro: A brown tabby with four perfect white socks and very strong opinions about your coffee.
Home.artAlt: Watercolor illustration of Çorap's two front legs: tabby fur that ends in a sharp line above pure white paws with pink toe beans.
Home.lessonBody: So we named her after them. She has never once taken them off.
Home.story1: This is Çorap. Brown tabby, green eyes, strong opinions.
Home.story3: Tabby fur on top. One sharp line. Then pure white — on all four paws.
Home.shopAllBody: Tees, hoodies, prints and stickers — each one inspected (and probably sat on) by Çorap.
Home.reviewsBody: Real words from real customers. Çorap reads every one (she doesn't).

Game.title: Catch the Sock
Game.intro: The laundry basket tipped over and Çorap's socks are everywhere. Catch them before the cucumber shows up — she hates cucumbers.
Game.how: Move with your mouse, finger or the ← → keys. Sock +1 · yarn +3 · cucumber −2. You have {seconds} seconds.
